messages:
maya: Heads up — saw a KMS unwrap for a request that should have been scoped to org-b, but the namespace claim resolved to org-a. Logs attached.

arjun: can you paste the request id + headers?

maya: ```
req_id=01C9Z7ABCDEF workspace_id=ws-948 org_id=org-b namespace_claim=ns-42 resolved_org=org-a auth_path=/v1/keys/projects/org-a/keys/key-7
kms_unwrap_status=OK
```

olivia: :eyes: that's bad. Is this during the namespace-affinity rollout?

maya: yes, right after the affinity sync job ran (cron at 02:00 UTC). timestamps align.

kevin: looks like a race between the affinity cache invalidation and live writes. If the resolver falls back to the global lookup it may pick the wrong owner.

sec-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: potential cross-org KMS unwrap detected for req 01C9Z7ABCDEF — severity P2. Ticket INC-2245 created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2245

arjun: immediate mitigation: roll back the affinity sync and disable global fallback in the resolver. i'll push the feature-flag off.

kevin: how to repro locally? quick loop: 
```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "X-Namespace: ns-42" http://internal-resolver/resolve | jq .owner; done
```

maya: repro reproduced — owner flips between org-a and org-b under concurrent requests.

olivia: hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9876 — adds stronger claim validation, avoids fallback, and emits a metric when owner != namespace_claim.owner. Can we hotpatch Dedicated and Private?

kevin: deploying to staging now. will run the smoke tests and promote if green in ~10m.

maya: audit note: collect all KMS unwrap logs for the last 24h and correlate with owner mapping snapshots. need to know if any customer data was exposed cross-org.

arjun: assigned: maya (logs + audit), kevin (hotpatch + deploy), olivia (postmortem + customer comms). update INC-2245 with findings.

kevin: deploy green on staging. feature-flag toggled off on prod, global fallback disabled. :thumbsup:

maya: confirmed no new mismatched unwraps in the last 5m after rollback. continuing to monitor.

olivia: please prepare a short customer-safe statement in case we need to notify — avoid calling out KMS details.

sec-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity reduced to P3. Notifying #oncall and #product channels.

maya: follow-ups: postmortem, add explicit resolver contract (require X-Namespace-Owner header or fail), remove global fallback permanently, add audit gating for KMS unwraps.

kevin: drafting RFC for resolver contract changes.

maya: moving detailed notes and logs into INC-2245. closing this Slack thread for now.
